spellbook.finance/limitations: The window covers the last seven UTC dates. Each oracle identity appears once; other qualifying printings can be omitted. At most 50 observations are returned.
detectedAt is a detection time, not proof of a current price, current inventory or a fresh detector run. provenance.fetchedAt is only this read's time.
These are observed candidates, not verified buyouts. The stored score is a detector heuristic, not a probability or recommendation. The tool adds no ranking or decision.
crossVendorConfirmed false can mean missing secondary observations or a move below the confirmation threshold; it does not establish that another source contradicted the observation.
The response does not establish finish, market-wide coverage or current supply. Empty observations do not distinguish no qualifying detection from an absent detector run.
Prices are stored USD observations. Source and card links identify evidence pages, not executable seller offers.

description: Read Magic price-spike observations from SpellBook Finance's buyout detector. Call it when asked which Magic cards are being bought out right now. Returns printing identity, old and new USD prices, fractional pctGain (0.25 means 25%), detection time, secondary-source confirmation, source links and explicit coverage gaps. Read guideResourceUri through MCP for interpretation and stop conditions. If guideUrl fails in a browser, spellbook_guides also discovers the guide's resourceUri. Observations are candidates, not verified buyouts. Call spellbook_card_prices with a row's scryfallId for current per-source price observations.
name: spellbook_buyouts
